measures.name: Public Measure LL (PCM Community School District GO Bond)
measures.jurisdiction: PCM Community School District (Monroe, Prairie City, Reasnor and PCM-area township ballot styles)
measures.ballotLanguage: Shall the Board of Directors of the PCM Community School District in the Counties of Jasper, Polk, and Marion, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $14,195,000 to provide funds to remodel, repair, improve, and equip the Monroe campus, including classroom and career and technical education spaces; to build, furnish, and equip an addition to the Monroe campus, including a multipurpose performance gymnasium, support spaces, and site improvements; and to improve the Prairie City campus site, including playgrounds and parking?

notes: Jasper County site is jasperia.org with elections at jaspercountyelections.iowa.gov. All sample ballots and the candidate list are scanned images; text obtained by local OCR (macOS Vision) at 300 dpi, with key sections visually verified. Board of Supervisors is at-large: 'Vote for no more than Two' with the same five candidates on all 48 ballot styles. Randy Lee Ray and Alyssa Wilson (Supervisor) and Joe Otto (Recorder) have no party label on the ballot (candidate list marks Ray and Wilson 'NP'). Township trustee races are vote-for-two. Empty candidate lists = no candidate printed (Elk Creek Twp Trustee and Clerk, Independence Twp Trustee vacancy). Every township ballot carries a township public measure asking whether the Board of Supervisors should fill that township's trustee and clerk offices by appointment; exact wording was verified on Washington, Des Moines, Elk Creek, Fairview, Mound Prairie and Palo Alto ballots and follows an identical template on the others (OCR on some ballots was partly garbled). No hospital trustee race.
